Name: Eemie's Crops for Json Assets - Updated
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Adds more pumpkins and melons to the game!
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT NEXUSMODS, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

Adds new pumpkin and melon varieties to the game via Json Assets.  This version is compatible with JA Version 1.3.0+ (which no longer supports the old content-pack format seen in Eemie's original mod).

This mod requires [Json Assets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720) to work.

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4!

Install

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/)﻿﻿.

2.  Install the latest version of [Json Assets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720)﻿.

3.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy the '[JA] Eemie's Crops' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  Play the game, you're done!
Version changes

*   1.3.2 - Adds context tags, fixes folder names

*   1.3.1 - Fixed naming issues, added templates for all supported languages.

*   1.3.0 - Added Korean translations, thanks to [Guccimochi](http://www.nexusmods.com/users/59574986)﻿!

*   1.2.0 - Added Spanish translations, thanks to [Ailer](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/41611600)﻿!

*   1.1.0 - Initial version
Credit for the original [mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1792) goes to [Eemiestardew](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34984615)﻿, who has kindly allowed me to take over their mods.


Source code found [here](https://github.com/minervamaga?tab=repositories)﻿.  Feel free to [submit a pull request](https://help.github.com/en/articles/creating-a-pull-request)﻿ with improvements or translations.  You can also [report issues or request features using the Issues tab](https://help.github.com/en/articles/creating-an-issue)﻿!
